The '''crew''' of [[Shai Tenna]] was a band of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], part of the major [[White Maw]] coalition, operating on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the last years of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="CX2" /> Despite his death, they were still in operation within the coalition years later during the [[Hidden Chain raids]] of the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="Hoth Pursuit">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Hoth Pursuit|Hoth}}</ref>
